designation.summary: On July 28, 2026 the FCC added to the Covered List foreign-produced advanced robotic devices, except those granted a Conditional Approval by the Department of War (DA 26-786, as cited in DA 26-996).

entries.conditions_summary: The FCC's list of robotic-device conditional approvals (Appendix B of DA 26-996 and later notices, most recently DA 26-1114) names Husqvarna AB's 305v IQ, 310v IQ, 420v IQ and 440v IQ robotic platforms, approved September 9, 2026, with no termination date. The notice number DA 26-957 is reported but not yet confirmed.

Exemption is “subject to ANSCER’s continuous compliance with the onshoring plan outlined in its conditional approval application and pursuant to updated vetting of its products.” No termination date; failure to comply or a misrepresentation could end the approval and return the equipment to the Covered List.

equipment: Automated guided vehicles and autonomous mobile robots (AGV/AMR)
entries.conditions_summary: The notice names the equipment by type only; no model numbers are listed. The FCC received the Department of War determination on October 15, 2026 and released the notice on October 16. Exemption is subject to continuing “compliance with the onshoring plan[s] outlined in [their] conditional approval application[s]” and “pursuant to updated vetting of [their] products”; failure to comply or a misrepresentation could end the approval.
